channel.title: New Guide | Emerging Tech & Applied Science Deep Dives
channel.description: Comprehensive technical research deep dives, engineering breakdowns, and tutorials on AI, quantum computing, applied physics, and metric engineering.

item.title: How Earth Generates Its Magnetic Field: The Physics of the Geodynamo
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: Earth's magnetic field is a self-sustaining magnetohydrodynamic dynamo powered by convection, rotation, and the cooling and chemical evolution of the liquid outer core.

item.title: How to Create a GitHub Repository and Add Code
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: Learn how to create a GitHub repository, connect it to a local project, commit your files, and push code safely from the command line.

item.title: Passive Radiative Cooling: The Physics of Cooling Without Power
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: How engineered surfaces reflect sunlight, emit infrared radiation through the atmospheric window, and reject heat to space without a compressor, refrigerant, or electrical input.

item.title: Neuromorphic Computing Explained: How Brain-Inspired Hardware Computes with Spikes
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: Neuromorphic computers replace clocked, data-hungry processing with sparse spikes, local memory, and event-driven dynamics. This guide explains the models, chips, trade-offs, and engineering opportunities behind the architecture.

item.title: Autonomous AI Agents: The System Architecture Beyond the LLM
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: An autonomous AI agent is not a larger prompt wrapped around an LLM. It is a closed-loop system combining state, planning, memory, tools, permissions, evaluation, and human oversight. This guide explains how those layers fit together—and where production systems fail.

item.title: The Post-Titanium Era: How Super Steel Could Scale Green Hydrogen Production
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: A new generation of corrosion-resistant “super steel” could replace selected titanium components in PEM electrolyzers, cutting material costs while surviving high-voltage, chloride-rich conditions.

item.title: Metric Engineering & Dynamic Spacetime Geometries: Beyond Alcubierre
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: Analyzing physical energy condition modifications, Lentz positive-energy soliton solutions, and pulsed electromagnetic field generation for sub-light and superluminal metric bubbles.

item.title: Fundamentals of Gravitational Field Modification & Metric Engineering
item.dc:creator: Vijayaramanan
item.description: A comprehensive investigation into theoretical paradigms, electromagnetic field coupling, and metric distortion equations governing non-Newtonian propulsion and gravitational shielding.
